Venue: KuCoin
Headline: Community Weekly Activity: KuStar Spotlight 🟩

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
🟩 Community Weekly Activity: KuStar Spotlight 🟩
It’s time to celebrate YOU! 💚 Each week, we’ll highlight one standout member who brought great energy to the group. Whether by being helpful, active, friendly, creative, or simply spreading the true KuCoin spirit.
📅 Winner revealed every Monday
🏆 Reward: The selected member will receive 100 bonus Points and a special shoutout in the channel
💬 Want to be featured? Stay active, support others, and keep bringing positive energy to the community.
Will this week’s spotlight be yours? 💚
